name: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt

status.en: 247 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 32% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 247 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 32 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces in Kashmir are conducting joint area domination exercises in Bandipora and Sopore along the Wullar axis as IGP Sujit Kumar warns that a single local terrorist remains active while the broader terror threat persists. In Manipur, hundreds rallied in Ukhrul demanding an end to ethnic violence and the SoO pact, while Naga groups petitioned the prime minister for a political solution and security forces launched operations to track perpetrators of recent violence. Maoist units in Chhattisgarh's Bijapur forest have hidden large caches, with forces recovering 711 BGL shells and a 5 kg pressure-cooker IED. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Kashmir gjennomfører felles område-dominansøvelser i Bandipora og Sopore langs Wullar-aksen, mens IGP Sujit Kumar advarer om at en enkelt lokal terrorist fortsatt er aktiv mens den bredere terrortrusselen vedvarer. I Manipur samlet hundrevis seg i Ukhrul og krevde en slutt på etnisk vold og SoO-avtalen, mens Naga-gruppene skrev et brev til statsministeren om en politisk løsning og sikkerhetsstyrker igangsatte operasjoner for å spore gjerningspersonene bak den nylige volden. Maoist-enheter i Chhattisgarh sin Bijapur-skog har skjult store lager, med styrker som har funnet 711 BGL-granater og en IED med 5 kg trykkoker. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
